name: semi-analytical modeling
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 结合部分解析表达与离散求解建立模型。
usage_overview: 用于结合解析表达与数值离散建立模型。在圆柱层结构动力建模中，将纵向、周向函数展开与径向数值插值结合，可减少计算自由度。

complete_examples.text: Railway tunnel Train-track-tunnel-soil coupled dynamics Soil dynamic stress Environmental vibration Cylindrical layer element Semi-analytical modeling A B S T R A C T A 3D train-track-tunnel-soil (TTTS) coupled dynamics model is developed in the time domain, where the spatial dynamic interactions between the subsystems can be characterized and captured.
Alterna-tively, the semi-analytical modeling method allows for larger soil sizes without compromising computational efficiency (Zhou et al., 2018; Zhang et al., 2018).
